item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nexpected=[]\\nfor request in requests:\\n    before_request=copy.deepcopy(request); before_policy=copy.deepcopy(policy)\\n    expected.append(evaluate(request,policy))\\n    assert request==before_request and policy==before_policy\\nassert report==expected,(report,expected)\\nassert evaluate({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','meta':1},'b':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':2,'hash':'x','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]})=={'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}\\nassert evaluate({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'},'y':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'},'y':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'}},{'ignored':['y']})=={'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}\\nassert evaluate({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{})=={'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}\\nprint('verified',len(requests),'report rows')\"]}"}
